content:
The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not mention enough high-priority shipment IDs.
The test_word_summary_content in /tests/test_outputs.py failed with 'AssertionError: Word summary must mention at least two high-priority shipment IDs' (assert 1 >= 2). While 5 tests passed, the generated OUTPUT_DOCX failed to include the required shipment ID strings from the top_shipments list. Avoid omitting specific shipment identifiers in the narrative summary; ensure the logic for identifying and writing high-priority IDs to the Document paragraphs is robust.
